technical_and_design_decisions: Utilize Spring Expression Language (SpEL) context for evaluating dynamic expressions in output file and directory paths (U6).
Expose configurable parameters for CodeGen and Merge operations via builder APIs and externalized configuration properties (U1, U2).
Integrate configurable execution timeout limits leveraging Java Future/Task executor cancellation and Spring Step Execution listeners (U3).
Implement a dedicated SQL execution Tasklet/Processor leveraging Spring JDBC ScriptUtils for executing raw SQL statements and scripts (U4).
Refactor JDBC ItemReader factory configuration to accept user-provided RowMapper<Tuple> implementations directly, bypassing custom subclassing requirements (U5).
Extend the CSV/FlatFile LineAggregator to support customizable escape characters for delimiters (U7).
Refactor MessageBus message transformation to use high-throughput zero-copy or direct buffer converters to minimize serialization overhead (U8).
assumptions: Development work is conducted on Java 17 using Spring Framework 6.x compatible baseline.
The target codebase already has established patterns for batch processing, JDBC reader components, and MessageBus abstractions.
All unit and integration testing will use standard testing libraries (JUnit 5, Mockito, H2/embedded database).
Performance benchmarking tools (JMCH/JMH) are available to measure MessageBus throughput optimizations.

activities.activity_description: Analyze requirements U1 through U8, design configuration options, API extensions, and refactoring strategy for MessageBus transformation.

activities.activity_name: CodeGen and Merge Options Parameterization (U1, U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement parameterized options for CodeGen and delta merge operations, including configuration bindings and validation.
Add timeout properties to job and step configurations and implement thread/task cancellation handling for hung jobs.
Create SQL processor and job tasklet implementations capable of parsing and executing inline SQL or external scripts.

activities.activity_name: Custom RowMapper<Tuple> Support in JDBC Reader (U5)
activities.activity_description: Enhance ItemReaderFactory and JDBC reader components to allow injecting user-defined RowMapper implementations directly.

activities.activity_name: SpEL Expression Support for Dynamic Naming (U6)
activities.activity_description: Integrate expression evaluation into file/directory writing components for dynamic path generation.
Update delimited line aggregators to support escaping delimiter characters in output files.
Refactor message transformation mechanisms within MessageBus, optimize memory allocation, and run throughput benchmarks.
Develop comprehensive unit and integration test suites covering all new user scenarios and verifying overall system stability.
Document new configuration options, API changes, usage examples for user stories, and prepare the release increment.
